value.description: Neutral grotesque, Inter/SF class (font inferred), regular weight, sentence case as spoken, starting lower case when the sentence continues ('isn't an idea yet.'), straight apostrophe, full stop only on sentence ends. White #FFFFFF, no shadow or box. Measured by row scan: capital A at 6.3 s spans rows 519-551, cap height 33 px of 1080 (3.0%); x-height about 25 px (2.3%) and glyph span 518-560 px at 8.0 s; implied font size about 46 px (4.2% of height) for an Inter-class face (inferred); OCR line box 0.038-0.046 of height. Width 12.7% ('It's obvious.') to 34.4% (the 30-character line) of frame width. Centred on x 0.50, baseline-centre at y 0.50 on every line. Appears and disappears in one frame, no animation.

Tiny monospaced-looking dimension labels ('314x211', '13x13') beside thin rectangles, about 0.021 of height (OCR boxes), white or tinted with the plate's grade; drawn on over 4 frames F10-F13 and tracked to the eye.

Degree readouts on the drawing (two values, the larger at x 0.50 y 0.23, OCR height 0.043) that count up frame by frame (170.4 to 172.1 over F155-F160) as the arc grows. Scattered single digits 0-9 in a light italic grotesque fly across F150-F154.

composition.value: Everything converges on frame centre. Captions sit on the exact centre (x 0.50, y 0.50); subjects are placed so that the caption overlaps their brightest part (the crescent's tip at about x 0.50 y 0.50, the caret through the middle of the line, the HUD cluster just below and right of centre at x 0.44-0.63, y 0.55-0.80). Plates are heavily vignetted, so 40-60% of every frame is near-black and the eye cannot leave the centre. The only off-centre elements are the HUD boxes and the technical drawing, whose crosshair sits at x 0.21 y 0.24 and whose lines run to the frame edges.

materials.value: Macro footage or CG with optical character (shallow depth of field, grain, chromatic fringing on grade steps): an eye, a light crescent on a dark sphere, a pen nib on paper, a hand on a keyboard, a droplet, glass domes, sparks. Graphic layers: a dot-matrix ring, thin-line HUD boxes, a line-art technical drawing, flat colour cards with a soft lighter rectangle, a thin glowing vertical caret. Whether the plates are filmed or rendered cannot be told from frames (inferred).

lighting.value: Low-key, single source per plate with heavy vignette; highlights clip on purpose (crescent core, droplet, caret glow). Grades jump between teal, magenta, monochrome, negative and cream, always as hard 1-3 frame steps, never as a dissolve. The caret carries a soft green-white bloom (#454B46 around a white core).

styleSummary: Dark cinematic teaser: tiny white centred captions over vignetted macro plates that are annotated, measured and re-graded in hard frame steps; one burst of 4-frame plates, then the picture empties to a caret on black.
